name: text-animate
title: Text Animate
description: A bold heading over a smaller grey caption, both built to fade, slide and blur into place word by word or character by character when scrolled into view.
use: A heading or tagline should enter with a soft staggered fade as it scrolls into view.
avoid: Content that must be readable instantly, since the entrance briefly hides the words.
a11y: A hidden span and aria-label expose the full text, but the entrance ignores reduced-motion preferences. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two centred lines on black: a thick white heading reading Animate your text beautifully, and below it a smaller grey sentence. There is generous space above and below the pair.
behaves: The words rise and sharpen from a blur in a staggered sequence, while the caption below fades one character at a time. The clip itself only catches the finished state.
customise: Pass the text as a string child and choose animation, by, delay, duration, as, startOnView, once and accessible, or supply your own variants; the presets live in the source.
weight: light: A short run of staggered opacity and blur tweens that stop once the text is revealed.
demo: The heading Animate your text beautifully above Each character fades in one by one.
issues: The clip only captures the finished text, so the entrance animation is never shown.
polishWhy: Clean typographic demo, but the recording shows none of the motion that defines it.
